design: Controlled multinomial precision and identification sweep; synthetic simulation only
scope: No API calls, model responses, human participants, or customer observations. Population names are inherited labels; near is not an assertion of zero contrast.
sampling: Independent multinomial calibration columns and independent multinomial field counts in every cell and replicate. Methods within a replicate share samples.
failure_policy: Infeasible or invalid intervals retained in unconditional coverage and resolution denominators; interval width quantiles conditional on feasibility. Distinguish wrong resolutions from all unresolved or failed cases.
